title: The critical role of microglia in the stress response
title_zh: 压力反应中的小胶质细胞关键作用
abstract: Microglia are the principal resident innate immune cells of the central nervous system (CNS). Beyond maintaining brain homeostasis via cytokine secretion and phagocytic clearance, they fulfill essential roles in synaptic pruning, oligodendrocyte maturation, and higher-order functions including learning and memory. In response to stress exposure, microglia undergo robust activation, characterized by morphological remodeling, altered phagocytic activity, and dysregulated inflammatory signaling, positioning them as active mediators of the integrated systemic stress response. This review systematically synthesizes preclinical and clinical evidence regarding the multifaceted contributions of microglia to stress processing, their mechanistic involvement in the pathogenesis of major stress-related disorders-including post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), major depressive disorder (MDD), Alzheimer's disease (AD), and Parkinson's disease (PD)-and summarizes emerging microglia-targeted therapeutic strategies. We underscore the substantial mechanistic and translational value of microglial research for advancing our understanding of stress adaptation and associated brain pathologies.
abstract_zh: 小胶质细胞是中枢神经系统（CNS）的主要驻留先天免疫细胞。除通过细胞因子分泌和吞噬清除维持脑稳态外，它们在突触修剪、少突胶质细胞成熟及学习和记忆等高级功能中也发挥关键作用。面对压力刺激，小胶质细胞会出现显著激活，表现为形态重塑、吞噬活性改变及炎症信号失衡，因此成为整合性系统性压力反应的主动介质。本综述系统整合了关于小胶质细胞在压力加工中的多层面作用证据，及其在主要压力相关障碍——包括创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）、重度抑郁障碍（MDD）、阿尔茨海默病（AD）和帕金森病（PD）——发病机制中的机制参与，并总结了新兴的小胶质细胞靶向治疗策略。我们强调小胶质细胞研究在推进对压力适应及相关脑病理理解方面具有重要的机制学与转化价值。
